topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: It's been a whirlwind of a week since I discovered that my online friend, someone I've chatted with regularly for the past two years, actually lives just a few blocks away from me. It’s one of those coincidences that make you pause and appreciate the connectivity of the world we live in. I’ve been planning the perfect meet-up, something that not only does justice to our friendship but also sets the tone for a new chapter in our lives. I’ve been poring over the details, from the cozy café where we’ll grab coffee to the hidden park we can explore. It’s exhilarating to see how the dots of our lives have connected in such an unexpected and delightful way.
